title: Bar Drop Lemon Lime 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: Bar Drop Salts Lemon Lime by Drop is the definitive citrus duo. It combines the sharp, zesty punch of yellow lemon with the slightly sweeter, aromatic tang of green lime. The result is a high-energy flavour profile that is exceptionally refreshing and perfect for vapers who avoid overly sweet or creamy blends. The 40% VG / 60% PG ratio is essential here, allowing the sharp acidity and zest of the citrus fruits to shine without being softened by high VG content. Designed for MTL (Mouth-to-Lung) vaping, the nicotine salt blend ensures a smooth, non-harsh throat hit in 5mg, 10mg, or 20mg strengths. Bar Drop Salts is a range of nic salt e-liquids from UK manufacturer, Drop, that specialises in creating fruity flavours of astonishing authenticity and clarity.
